description.p: steamtrain scans the Steam games you actually have installed and sets launch options suited to your own hardware, desktop session and helper tools, rather than copying options submitted from someone else's machine.
It is deliberately conservative and never acts behind your back:

ul.li: It never overwrites a launch option you set yourself.
It never writes while Steam is running, because Steam would discard the change on exit.
It backs up localconfig.vdf before every write and can revert everything it did.
